headline: Argentina Registers First Soybean Operations Under 'Soja Visec' System
summary: Initial agricultural transactions under the 'Soja Visec' framework have been registered in Argentina, featuring a price differential of $10 per ton.

impacts.name: Soybean
impacts.why: New traceability and pricing frameworks impact agricultural commodity delivery terms and producer revenues.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
